source.note: supportWindows transcribed mechanically from the vendor's own 'Kyverno Version / Kubernetes Min / Kubernetes Max' compatibility table, each minor read on ITS OWN docs branch (the row moves: main's table before 2026-04-14 listed 1.18.x as 1.32-1.35, the release-1-18-0 branch lists 1.33-1.35, which is what is shipped). From 1.18 the table is replaced by releases.md 'Kubernetes Versions Supported' (1.19: v1.33 - v1.35, 1.20: v1.34 - v1.37). The page says "Other Kubernetes versions may work, but are not tested and therefore no guarantees are made as to their full compatibility." NEVER derive a window from go.mod (k8s.io/client-go). Support policy (blog announcing-kyverno-release-1.18 'Updated Support Policy'): from 1.18 Kyverno follows a "main + 1" patch support model -> supportedMinorsBehindLatest 1 against latestKnownVersion; no EOL dates are published, so no window carries one. Detection: the admission controller image repository ends in kyverno/kyverno (ghcr.io/kyverno/kyverno, reg.kyverno.io/kyverno/kyverno and mirrors); the init container kyverno/kyvernopre, the background/cleanup/reports controllers, kyverno/kyverno-cli and kyverno/reports-server never match on their own, and Nirmata Enterprise Kyverno (ghcr.io/nirmata/kyverno) is a separate build and is not claimed. The stray tag v1.15.20 has no GitHub release (chart appVersion v1.15.2) and is never read. Rules and upgrade notes do NOT live here: they are the hand-authored corpus in k8s-rules/kyverno/ (1.10-1.20, one file per minor, hop-scoped), built by scripts/readiness-agent/build-kyverno-rules.py from kb/kyverno/notes-<minor>.md, which scripts/readiness-agent/extract-kyverno-notes.py extracts verbatim from the release bodies, the website upgrade guide on each minor's docs branch, the release blogs, the chart README and CHANGELOG.md.
